summary: Excellent corpus-grounded knowledge-only skill for the validation layer with rigorous numbers discipline. Quote integrity: 42 verifications, all passed — 25 '(transcript)'-labeled quotes verified verbatim across five transcripts, including the flagship RdnJw-mhwlE demo chain (backtest purpose declaration, 100/200-trade sample floor, the 11-consecutive-loss / 300 return pair, screenshot habit, don't-lose-confidence), the full PypFn7GaVfE 100-trade-challenge segment with both paid-course binding quotes (7.0 online course assignment framing and the one-year mentorship line), the rLP-MPvGmDE system-confidence data list (expected return / consecutive losses / consecutive wins / Average Risk Rewards Ratio), the 54WCm_VBYfY sample-pollution and law-of-large-numbers quotes, and the MjPZizFnX-E quarterly-review / equity-curve / Tradzilla quotes; plus 17 note-level quotes across ten more videos. Anti-injection is clean: walk-forward, Monte Carlo, in-sample/out-of-sample, and overfitting appear exclusively inside the three ban fences (intro, Prerequisite 1, Limitation 1), and NqixhiGBt9E — confirmed absent from both the notes and transcripts directories — is cited only in 'not in corpus, do not backfill interface details' statements. Numbers discipline is exemplary: the 300-percent inference is marked 推測 at every occurrence (ASR has no unit), the MjPZizFnX-E 40% win-rate denominator caveat is carried in full (19/47 vs 19/39, the 8 unaccounted trades flagged as inferred breakeven, and the same-video below-50% quote), and the sample-size calibers (10 / 50-100 / 100-200) are presented as purpose-layered tiers in the Step 4 table with an explicit no-merge limitation. The 100-trade challenge is correctly framed as paid-course homework with only the public parts (sample method, system positioning, personality matching — the latter honestly marked 歸納) represented and the five-system rules deferred with a 保留內容 flag. DRY routes system rules to price-action/liquidity, risk numbers to risk-management, exam scenes to prop-firm, and exits to exit-management, consistent with the sibling ledger. 單源/推測 flags are consistent throughout (multi-system framework single-source, 小之星/大樹法則/Tradzilla/辨制 corrections, the 10,000-hour figure marked as personal preference not a rule). Only minor provenance-signaling nits remain.

findings.message: The vocabulary quick-table's 樣本量門檻 row quotes only the 100/200-trade backtest caliber, with no signal that Step 4 layers three more purpose-specific tiers (10/100 before small-capital, 50-100 before prop exams, 100-per-unit for the probability model). A reader stopping at the quick table sees a single number — the exact merge the skill's own Limitation 6 forbids.
findings.improvement: Append a tier marker to the row, e.g. 「（分層口徑，見 Step 4——用途唔同門檻唔同）」, matching the multi-caliber signaling convention used across this skill family.

findings.message: Step 2 states 「bar-by-bar 唔睇後市（B7rumsOw6_U 全片示範）」 without the provenance caveat that evidence.md line 20 carries (筆記歸納，非引文) — the claim is a summary of an entire demo video, not a quotable rule, but SKILL.md presents it with the same weight as quoted rules.
